title: Translation and Journalistic Writing

papers.paper_title: EXAMINATION PAPER 1: THIRD SEMESTER MGU-UGP(HONS.) REGULAR EXAM OCT 2025

questions.question: Which of the following is a widely used AI-powered translation tool / developed by Google? a). DeepL b). Bing Translate c). Google Translate d). Amazon Translate
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (c) Google Translate

questions.question: What is the primary goal of translation in advertisements? / a). To reproduce every word b). To make the ad longer than the literally original c). To persuade and connect with d). To remove cultural elements for the target audience emotionally neutrality and culturally
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (c) To persuade and connect with the target audience emotionally and culturally
questions.final_answer: Option (c) To persuade and connect with the target audience emotionally and culturally

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of editorial writing? / a).Personal bias of the individual b). Persuasive tone writer c).Authoritative style d). Clear argument
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (a) Personal bias of the individual writer
questions.final_answer: Option Personal bias of the individual writer

questions.question: The language of an article should be: / a). Unclear and technical b).Formal, clear, and reader- friendly c). Filled with jargon d). Extremely casual
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (b) Formal, clear, and reader-friendly

questions.question: The main purpose of a feature article is to: / a).Provide immediate breaking b). Offer in-depth background, news analysis, and human interest c). Report only factual updates d). Present statistics alone
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (b) Offer in-depth background, analysis, and human interest
questions.final_answer: Option (b) Offer in-depth background, analysis, and human interest

questions.question: In terms of placement, editorials are usually found in: / a). The opinion/editorial page b). The advertisement section c). The front page d). The last page always
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (a) The opinion/editorial page

questions.question: Recall the condition of translation in which the source and the translated text / perform the same function a). Formal equivalence b). Acculturation c). Functional equivalence d). Domestication
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (c) Functional equivalence

questions.question: A balanced news report means: / a). Giving equal importance to all b). Reporting only one side sides of an issue c). Adding personal bias d). Making it more dramatic
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (a) Giving equal importance to all sides of an issue
questions.final_answer: Option Giving equal importance to all sides of an issue

questions.question: What is the initial stage of translation process / a). Transfer b). Source Language Text analysis c). Recoding d). Transediting
questions.solution_html: Correct Option: Option (b) Source Language Text analysis

questions.question: The technique of equivalence in media translation ensures: / a). Exact word-for-word meaning b). Recreating the same impact or effect in the target audience c). Avoiding idioms and metaphors d). Shortening the news text
questions.solution_html:
• b) Recreating the same impact or effect in the target audience
  • Short Answer Type Questions (100 Words)
questions.final_answer: Option (b) Recreating the same impact or effect in the target audience

questions.question: Explain the role of creative writing in media industry
questions.solution_html:
• Creative writing in the media industry helps produce engaging, original, and impactful
  • content across platforms like advertising, television, digital media, journalism, and film. It
  • enhances storytelling, captures audience interest, builds emotional connection, and adds
  • artistic value to factual or promotional messages. Creative writing also strengthens brand
  • identity, improves message recall, and allows media professionals to communicate complex
  • ideas in accessible and imaginative ways.
questions.final_answer: ideas in accessible and imaginative ways

questions.question: What is literal translation and when is it used in journalism?
questions.solution_html:
• Literal translation is a word-for-word rendering of a source text, preserving original structure
  • and vocabulary as closely as possible. In journalism, it is used when accuracy and neutrality
  • are crucial—such as translating official statements, legal documents, speeches, data, and
  • direct quotes—where altering wording may change meaning or cause misinterpretation.
questions.final_answer: direct quotes—where altering wording may change meaning or cause misinterpretation

questions.question: What is “engagement” in social media writing?
questions.solution_html:
• Engagement refers to the level of interaction users have with social media content. It includes
  • likes, comments, shares, saves, clicks, reactions, and time spent viewing. High engagement
  • indicates that the content is relevant, relatable, and effective in prompting user participation
  • discussions, or community building.

questions.question: Explain significance of translation in global news organizations
questions.solution_html:
• Translation enables global news organizations to gather, distribute, and share information
  • across linguistic boundaries. It ensures fast dissemination of worldwide events, helps
  • maintain accuracy while reporting international stories, and allows news agencies to reach
  • diverse audiences. Translation supports cross-cultural understanding, reduces
  • misinformation, and strengthens global connectivity in journalism.
questions.final_answer: misinformation, and strengthens global connectivity in journalism

questions.question: Discuss intersemiotic translation with examples
questions.solution_html:
• Intersemiotic translation (Roman Jakobson) refers to translating meaning from one sign
  • system to another—not between languages, but between different modes such as text, image
  • sound, or film.
  • Examples: A novel adapted into a film, A poem turned into a painting or music, A news
  • report converted into an infographic, A historical event represented as a documentary.
questions.final_answer: report converted into an infographic, A historical event represented as a documentary

questions.question: What is creative writing
questions.solution_html:
• Creative writing is a form of expressive writing that uses imagination, narrative craft, and
  • artistic techniques to convey ideas, emotions, and stories. It includes genres such as fiction
  • poetry, drama, scripts, and personal essays. It emphasizes originality, figurative language
  • character development, and engaging storytelling.

questions.question: Explain processes of gate keeping and transediting in journalistic translation
questions.solution_html:
• Gatekeeping
  • The selection, filtering, and control of news content by editors or journalists. In translation
  • gatekeeping decides which foreign stories are chosen, what information is included or
  • excluded, and how content aligns with editorial policies.
  • Trans editing
  • A blend of translation, editing, and rewriting. Journalists modify the original text to suit space
  • limits, cultural expectations, style guidelines, or clarity requirements. It may involve
  • summarizing, reorganizing, simplifying, or adapting content to fit the target audience and
  • medium.

questions.question: How does audience diversity influence translation choices in journalism?
questions.solution_html:
• Audience diversity influences translators to adapt language, tone, cultural references, and
  • examples to ensure comprehension across varied demographic, linguistic, and cultural
  • groups. They may avoid idioms, simplify complex terms, provide context, and maintain
  • neutral or inclusive language to cater to multicultural and multilingual audiences.
questions.final_answer: neutral or inclusive language to cater to multicultural and multilingual audiences

questions.question: How does timing affect script writing for broadcast?
questions.solution_html:
• Timing determines the length, pace, and structure of broadcast scripts. Writers must ensure
  • that content fits strict time slots and is delivered at a pace suitable for listeners/viewers.
questions.final_answer: Timing determines the length, pace, and structure of broadcast scripts. Writers must ensure

questions.question: Explain advantages of computer assisted translation
questions.solution_html:
• CAT tools assist human translators using technology such as translation memory
  • terminology databases, and alignment tools. Advantages include: Faster translation with
  • increased efficiency- Consistency in terminology and phrasing-Reduced errors- Reuse of
  • previous translations-better collaboration among translators-Ability to handle large projects
  • systematically.

questions.question: How do cultural references affect subtitle translation?
questions.solution_html:
• Cultural references may not have direct equivalents in the target language, making subtitle
  • translation challenging. Translators must adapt, simplify, or replace references with culturally
  • understandable alternatives while preserving meaning. Misalignment can cause confusion or
  • loss of humour, emotion, or context. Space and time constraints in subtitles make this
  • adaptation even more crucial.

questions.question: Explain the role of personal voice in column writing.
questions.solution_html:
• Personal voice in column writing adds individuality, perspective, and emotion to a writer’s
  • opinion. It differentiates the columnist’s style, builds reader trust, and creates a recognizable
  • persona. Personal voice allows use of humor, anecdotes, rhetorical devices, and subjective
  • interpretation to engage readers and make commentary more relatable and persuasive.
  • Essay Type Questions (450 Words)

questions.question: Explain process of feature writing and categorization of features.
questions.solution_html:
• Process
  • Idea selection-Research (primary & secondary)-Decide angle/focus
  • Outline/structureAttractive lead-Body with facts, quotes, descriptions-Conclusion with
  • message/impactEditing & fact-checking
  • Categorization: Human-interest-Profile-Informative/explanatory-Historical-Lifestyle
  • Science & tech-Cultural-Investigative etc.

questions.question: How does translation influence global media accessibility and cultural / exchange in the digital age?
questions.solution_html:
• Makes global media accessible (subtitles, dubbing, multilingual news)
  • Promotes cross-cultural understanding-Supports international journalism (wire reports, global
  • news flow)-Expands global entertainment markets (films, OTT, music)-Enables digital
  • knowledge exchange (research, e-learning)-Helps social media interaction across languages.
questions.final_answer: knowledge exchange (research, e-learning)-Helps social media interaction across languages

questions.question: “A translator in journalism is also a cultural mediator.” Discuss with / examples.
questions.solution_html:
• A translator in journalism does more than convert words from one language to another—they
  • interpret cultural meanings so that the audience truly understands the message- explains
  • cultural references, idioms, metaphors-Provides contextual meaning beyond literal
  • translation-Ensures cultural sensitivity (religion, caste, politics)-Adapts tone/style for target
  • audience-Prevents cultural distortion or stereotypes.

questions.question: Explain the importance of clarity and simplicity in journalistic writing, / especially in the digital age.
questions.solution_html:
• Clarity and simplicity are essential qualities of journalistic writing today: Readers Have Short
  • Attention Spans-Information Overload- Straightforward writing helps the story stand out.
  • Mobile-First Consumption-Global Readership-News reaches multilingual audiences.
  • Clear, direct sentences improve visibility and ranking on search platforms-Accuracy and
  • Transparency-Social Media Sharing-Inclusivity etc.
